# special-measures

> Machine-readable FinCEN special measures (section 311, section 9714, FEND Off Fentanyl 2313a) with Federal Register citations, status on any date, and counterparty screening. Engineering checklist, not legal advice.

The registry lists 20 FinCEN actions as of 2026-11-16, each with dated, cited events. The screener matches names, domains and jurisdictions and reports hit, review, pending, watch or info for a payment date.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/README.md): Why, what is in the registry, usage, matching rules, limits.
- [docs/sources.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/docs/sources.md): Every event with its citation and source URL, and notes on reading the sources.
- [docs/benchmarks.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md): Screening throughput.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for screening counterparties with this package.

## Source

- [data/measures.json](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/src/specialmeasures/data/measures.json): The registry.
- [registry.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/src/specialmeasures/registry.py): Schema validation and status on a date.
- [normalize.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/src/specialmeasures/normalize.py): Name folding and legal-form removal.
- [screen.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/src/specialmeasures/screen.py): Matching and dispositions.
- [watch.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/special-measures/blob/main/src/specialmeasures/watch.py): Federal Register API check for documents the registry does not cite.
